events.text: The simulator reaches the win in 293 moves. Checking it with the real rules:

I solved the level in 293 moves, and the checker reports "WON after 293 moves".

**How it works:** The door at (27,17) is on a separate island. The trader can't walk there, but the mirror can move it. Each reflection moves a thing along a diagonal line, and every jump on the route ends in open water. So the 4 crystals are reflected into the water one after another, where they sink and become stepping tiles. All of them sit on the diagonal x − y = 12:

| Tile | Mirror spot for the jump onto it |
|---|---|
| (39,27) | (44,27) |
| (48,36) | (48,27) |
| (33,21) | (48,21) |
| (52,40) | (52,21) |

1. **Feeding the crystals in:** The crystals are pushed one at a time to (44,32), then reflected along the chain. Each crystal travels across the tiles already sunk and stops on the first open water, extending the chain by one tile.
2. **Moving trader #1 over:** Once all 4 tiles exist, trader #1 stands at (44,32) and is reflected along the same chain. Trader #7 does all the mirror pushing in between.
3. **Finish:** Trader #7 pushes the mirror up to (52,16), steps aside onto the door at (53,17) and presses X. That sends trader #1 24 cells, from (52,40) to (28,16). Trader #1 then walks down and left onto the door at (27,17).
